# Product Overview

## Purpose and users

Purchase requests raised by employees and decided by an approver (F-001, F-002). Who the users are beyond "requester" and "approver" is a gap.

## Product capabilities

- Approve a pending request (F-001).
- Reject a pending request (F-002).

## Business objectives and unknowns

Business objectives are not stated in the repository. The approval limit is contradictory (BR-002).

## Baseline

- Revision: gap — the fixture has no Git metadata.
- Scope: whole repository (`src/`, `tests/`, `README.md`), confirmed by the Product Owner.
- Exclusions: none.
- Owners (CODEOWNERS): not declared.
